notes: Abell 1656 (Godwin+1983); ~1000 bright members. Highest σ_v (1082 km/s) of any nearby cluster. Bimodal: NGC4889 (N) + NGC4874 (S) co-BCGs — no single dominant peak. NGC4889 ultra-massive BH ~21 billion M☉. NGC4921: anemic spiral — HI stripped, dramatically reduced star formation. Not a cooling flow cluster (ICM sloshing from recent merger).
